j-topup.title: Customer tops up the wallet
j-topup.summary: Alex adds UGX 75,000 to the LoadMaster wallet with Airtel Money. The demo approves instantly; the balance on Home updates and operations sees the top-up in the money ledger.

steps.label: Home shows the wallet balance. Tap Add funds.
The Add funds sheet opens with the current balance.
Enter the amount and choose Airtel Money.
Approve the demo top-up: success confirmation.
POST /account/wallet · wallet_topup posted to the ledger (customer wallet ← Airtel Money)
Close the sheet: Home shows the new balance.
Transfers ledger lists the wallet top-up.
Collections and reconciliation stay balanced.

j-payout.title: Driver is paid out
j-payout.summary: Brian withdraws UGX 150,000 of unpaid earnings to Airtel Money. Operations reviews the request and approves it for finance payment; Brian sees the request move on in the app.

steps.label: Earnings shows scheduled (unpaid) earnings.
Open payout requests: choose an amount and a payout platform.
Enter UGX 150,000 and pick Airtel Money.

j-driver-onboarding.title: New driver registers and gets verified
j-driver-onboarding.summary: Grace creates a driver account, confirms the demo code, adds her truck and submits the four required documents. Operations approves each document and then the driver, after which Grace can go online.

steps.label: Driver app sign-in. Tap Create account.
Registration form.
Fill name, phone, email and password.
Create account: enter the demo verification code.
Verify & continue: Home asks for verification before going online.
Account › Vehicle & verification: nothing submitted yet.
Edit vehicle details: model and licence plate.
Submit vehicle for review.
POST /account/document ×4 · Driver licence, Identity document, Vehicle registration, Third-party insurance (photos picked on the phone)
All four documents submitted: awaiting review.
Drivers list: Grace is awaiting review.
Driver page: vehicle and documents to review.
Documents tab › Review the driver licence: Approve, with a note.
Save, then approve the other three documents the same way.
Approve driver & vehicle.
Confirm: Grace is an approved driver.
Vehicle & verification now shows Grace as approved.
Home: verified, Grace can go online.

j-customer-signup.title: New customer creates an account
j-customer-signup.summary: A new customer registers in the customer app, confirms the demo code and lands on Home ready to order a truck.

steps.label: Customer app sign-in. Tap Create account.
Registration form.
Fill name, phone, email and password.
Create account: enter the demo verification code.
Verify & continue: Home, ready to order.
